name: @merit/golden-loader
description: CI-03. Reads packages/rules-engine/fixtures and folds each day stream through the engine's public entry point. It cannot reach the engine's internals, which is what keeps TR-01 enforceable.
//: IT DEPENDS ON THE ENGINE AND THE ENGINE DEPENDS ON NOTHING. The arrow points this way on purpose: RI-01 asserts packages/rules-engine declares no workspace dependency, so the loader can never become something the engine imports. `@merit/rules-engine` resolves through that package's `exports` map, which publishes `.` and nothing else, so `../rules-engine/src/floor.js` is not reachable from here at all.
//fast-check: PT-06's harness randomizes `TZ` per case, which needs `process`, which the engine package does not have (`types: []`, deliberately). So the harness and the properties that use it live here, and the generator library comes with them. It is a devDependency, it is already in the catalog and already installed for @merit/rules-engine, so it adds no package to the tree that VG-12 has not already admitted.
